newsitem.title: FRANCE: Kohl says Buba gold could be used for E German debt.
newsitem.headline: Kohl says Buba gold could be used for E German debt.

text.p: German Chancellor Helmut Kohl said on Tuesday revaluation of the Bundesbank's gold reserves could be used to pay off debt inherited from former East Germany but would not be used towards the current federal budget.

Kohl said neither the scale nor details of the gold revaluation had yet been agreed between the Bonn government and the German central bank. He insisted there was no question of actually selling off gold.

"Upon reunification, the Federal Republic took on heavy debts which we have to bear," Kohl told a news conference. "If we reach a certain agreement (on gold revaluation) we would put the money into this (solidarity) fund to pay off these debts, he said.
"Neither the scale nor the details have been decided," he added.
"It is not the aim to bring the gold into the federal budget," he said prior to a dinner with French President Jacques Chirac.
